item.title: Indiana QB Fernando Mendoza wins Maxwell and O’Brien awards; Heisman on deck
item.description: Fernando Mendoza of Indiana has won the Davey O'Brien Award as the nation's top quarterback and is the overwhelming favorite to win the Heisman Trophy.

item.title: Politics panel: Indiana senators likely to survive challenges over redistricting
item.description: Two members of Indiana's political team said that the Republican state senators who rejected new congressional maps are unlikely to lose their seats over the vote, as they are deeply rooted and entrenched in their communities.

item.title: Indianapolis police ID suspects in fatal drag racing crash
item.description: Indianapolis police on Friday identified Angel Osuvaldo-Franco and Ricardo Martinez-Valadez as the people believed to be responsible for a fatal hit-and-run crash that killed a person on Thursday morning. Police think they were drag racing in their vehicles.

item.title: Where IU’s Fernando Mendoza will keep the Heisman if he wins
item.description: IU quarterback Fernando Mendoza is looking to become the first Hoosier player to win the Heisman Trophy and plans to keep the trophy in Bloomington if he wins.

item.title: Suspect in Thanksgiving arson, double murder arrested after hospital release
item.description: Jaren Morgan, 18, was arrested and taken into custody after crashing his car during a police chase, and is facing charges of four counts of murder, two counts of robbery resulting in serious bodily injury, and arson for the Thanksgiving Day murders of his father and his father's girlfriend.

item.title: FDA intends to put its most serious warning on Covid vaccines, sources say
item.description: The FDA is planning to put a "black box" warning on Covid-19 vaccines, which has been met with criticism from outside experts and public health officials, who argue that there is no basis for the warning.

item.title: THE ZONE: Scores and Highlights – December 12, 2025
item.description: "The Zone" featured highlights from nine high school boys basketball games from across central Indiana on Friday, including Noblesville at Carmel, Zionsville at Lawrence Central, and more.

item.title: Son arrested in homicide of 81-year-old father in Indianapolis
item.description: Bryan Pedigo, 54, was arrested in connection to the homicide of his 81-year-old father and the injury of his father's wife. Indianapolis police found the couple in their home during a Thursday afternoon welfare check.

item.title: Referee collapses, dies during girls basketball game in Monrovia
item.description: A referee collapsed and died during a girls basketball game at Monrovia High School, prompting the game to be suspended.

item.title: Several inches of snow possible Saturday, record cold potential Sunday | Dec. 12, 2025
item.description: Hoosiers should prepare for a weekend of accumulating snow and brutal cold, with winter weather advisories and storm warnings in effect, followed by dangerous wind chills and record cold temperatures for Dec. 14. Relief will arrives with warmer temperatures and rain chances by Thursday.
